snippet.title: BOXROOM - A Home For Your Steam Library
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4335460/BOXROOM/?curator_clanid=44101319

BOXROOM is a builder/designer sim giving you the space to put a stamp on your Steam library. After setting up your room and preferred shelving arrangement, the game will boot your ACTUAL steam library onto the shelves - giving you space to arrange, curate and explore your collection as you see fit.

Follow Pantaloon on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Pantaloon?action=follow
